<brief>
Create a playful living-garden simulator.

The app shows a small round world with fruit trees, blue blobs, and red blobs. The user can tune the rules, press play, and watch the three groups rise and fall over time.

The experience should feel like a cute animated ecology toy: a little tabletop world with moving bean-shaped characters, visible fruit, live controls, and charts that tell the story of what happened.
</brief>

<freedom>
Use creative freedom. Choose the layout, controls, visuals, algorithms, and technical approach that make the experience strongest.

This prompt gives direction, not a strict checklist. The important part is that the world feels alive, the numbers come from the simulation, and the user can understand cause and effect.
</freedom>

<world>
The world is a round 3D-looking map, like a tiny raised garden dish.

Good visual direction:

- A circular map the user can drag to rotate.
- Trees or bushes with green fruit.
- Blue glossy oval blobs with simple faces.
- Red glossy oval blobs with simple faces.
- Soft shadows, depth, bouncing, blinking, leaning, and small personality.
- Click a blob to inspect it.

Food should look attached to plants. When a blob uses fruit, the plant should visibly have less fruit, then slowly grow fruit again later.
</world>

<simulation>
Each blue and red blob has energy.

Energy changes over time:

- Moving uses energy.
- Waiting uses a little energy.
- Blue blobs restore energy from fruit.
- Red blobs restore energy after a gentle contact interaction with blue blobs.
- Making a new blob uses stored energy, so group size cannot grow for free.
- Fruit returns slowly after being used.

These simple rules should create natural waves:

- More fruit helps blue blobs grow.
- More blue blobs helps red blobs grow.
- Too many red blobs lowers the blue group.
- If blue blobs become rare, red blobs run low on energy and fade.
- With balanced settings, the blue and red groups should rise and fall out of phase.

Do not fake the chart curves. The waves should come from the energy rules.
</simulation>

<motion>
The blobs should visibly choose what they are doing.

Blue blobs can look for fruit, gather near trees, wander, avoid crowded areas, or move away from nearby red blobs.

Red blobs can look for blue blobs, wander when none are nearby, and pause briefly after a successful contact interaction.

Eating and contact should have short cute animations: a pause, chew, bounce, glow, sparkle, fruit shrink, or energy pulse. These pauses should affect behavior so blobs cannot instantly repeat the same action over and over.
</motion>

<controls>
Give the user controls that feel like tuning a living toy.

Useful controls:

- Fruit growth speed.
- Fruit limit.
- Fruit return delay.
- Blue blob energy use.
- Blue blob speed.
- Blue blob vision.
- Blue blob copy threshold.
- Blue blob eating time.
- Red blob energy use.
- Red blob speed.
- Red blob vision.
- Red blob contact strength.
- Red blob copy threshold.
- Red blob pause time.
- Starting fruit trees.
- Starting blue blobs.
- Starting red blobs.
- World size.
- Random seed.
- Simulation speed.

Include play, pause, step, reset, randomize, and a few presets such as balanced garden, fruit-rich garden, red-heavy garden, fragile balance, and low-fruit garden.
</controls>

<charts>
Show the story with real charts from recorded history.

The main chart should show fruit, blue blobs, and red blobs together on one timeline. Use any readable scaling that keeps all three visible at once.

Helpful extra views:

- A blue-vs-red phase plot.
- A run summary.
- Trait trends if the blobs can inherit traits.

The summary can say things like:

- The garden stayed balanced.
- Blue blobs grew first, then red blobs followed.
- Low fruit kept the garden small.
- One group faded and the world settled into a simpler state.
</charts>

<inspection>
When the user clicks a blob, show useful details:

- Group color.
- Energy.
- Age.
- Current action.
- Speed.
- Sensing range.
- Time left in any eating or pause animation.
- Traits or family info if included.
</inspection>

<quality>
A strong result should demonstrate:

- Long-running waves between blue and red groups.
- A fruit-rich setting where blue blobs grow quickly.
- A low-fruit setting where the whole garden stays small.
- A red-heavy setting where blue blobs dip first and red blobs fade later.
- Group sizes that level out instead of growing forever.

Prioritize believable emergent behavior, clear controls, readable charts, and charming map animation.
</quality>

Work only inside the current working directory. Do not read, list, search, or edit files outside the current working directory. Treat it as a standalone project root.
During setup, configure your app and package scripts to use port 9228, then use that port for runtime verification.
Use pnpm exclusively if dependency installation or package scripts are needed. Do not use npm.
Set the browser title and the primary visible title to your model name, using only identity information already available to you. Add nothing else to either title.
Run the relevant checks yourself. Do not edit files outside the current working directory.

  fruitGrowth: number

  seed: 7,
}

export interface Preset {
  id: string
  name: string
  emoji: string
  blurb: string
  params: Partial<Params>
}

export const PRESETS: Preset[] = [
  {
    id: 'balanced',
    name: 'Balanced garden',
    emoji: '🌿',
    blurb: 'Blue and red take gentle turns.',
    params: {},
  },
  {
    id: 'fruit-rich',
    name: 'Fruit-rich garden',
    emoji: '🍏',

    params: { fruitGrowth: 0.2, fruitLimit: 9, fruitDelay: 2, trees: 18, startBlue: 50, startRed: 6 },

  {
    id: 'red-heavy',
    name: 'Red-heavy garden',
    emoji: '🍓',
    blurb: 'Lots of red. Blue dips first, red fades later.',

---
name: portly
description: Manage persistent projects and temporary local processes with the Portly macOS app and CLI. Use when an agent needs to run, start, stop, restart, inspect logs or health, configure projects and ports, adopt external listeners, resolve port conflicts, or enable launch at login.
---

# Portly

Use the `portly` CLI as the primary interface. Every command launches Portly.app automatically if needed; this is a state-changing side effect even for `status` when the app was closed.

If `portly` is not available on `PATH`, use the onboarding-installed CLI at `$HOME/.local/bin/portly`, or the copy bundled with the app at `/Applications/Portly.app/Contents/Resources/portly-cli`.

## Inspect first

Run `portly status` for the compact active/problem view. Use `portly status --details` only when you need stopped servers, IDs, uptime, or resource metrics, and `portly status --json` when code needs structured fields. Use an exact server ID or `project/server` when names are ambiguous.

## Keep the project rules durable

Whenever setting up Portly for a repository, ensure its root `AGENTS.md` tells agents to use Portly for every persistent development server. Add the following rule if an equivalent rule is not already present; preserve all existing instructions and never duplicate it:

```md
## Development servers

- Always use Portly (`portly ...`) to start, stop, restart, inspect, or keep local development servers running.
- Start with `portly status`. Use `portly status --details` only for the full inventory and metrics, and `--json` only for machine-readable fields. Reuse a healthy managed server; if an in-scope server is running outside Portly, register it and use `portly take-over <project/server> --json`.
- For long-lived or reusable work, create a project and server.
- For builds, tests, code generation, previews, demos, and other bounded one-off work, run `job_id="$(portly temp '<command>' --path <folder> --timeout 30m)"`, then `portly wait "$job_id"`. `temp` returns immediately with an ID; `wait` prints captured logs and exits with the command's real code. A timeout kills the whole process group and exits with code `124`.
- Never launch persistent development servers directly, in the background, or through another supervisor.
```

The Portly installer also adds this rule, between `portly:managed-rule` markers, to `~/.agents/AGENTS.md` as a machine-wide fallback. Repository instructions remain useful for collaborators and environments that do not share that global file.

## Command reference

| Command | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `status`, `list`, `ls` | Compact active/problem view; add `--details` for the full inventory |
| `temp`, `temporary`, `run-temp` | Run a short-lived process outside any project |
| `wait` | Wait for a temporary job and return its real exit code |
| `action` | Run a configured maintenance action without restarting the server |
| `memory-limit`, `ram-limit` | Show or configure automatic project restarts by footprint |
| `start`, `stop`, `restart` | Control a server or every server in `--project` |
| `logs` | Read captured output with `--tail` |
| `add-project`, `add-server`, `update-server`, `remove` | Manage configuration |
| `take-over`, `adopt` | Move an external listener under Portly |
| `port`, `kill-port` | Inspect or explicitly stop a port occupant |
| `open`, `quit`, `config` | Control the app or read its configuration |
| `forever enable\|status\|disable` | Manage launch at login through the macOS LaunchAgent |

Run `portly <command> --help` for exact flags. Use `--json` when structured fields are actually needed; `config` prints JSON or a path directly.

## Choose project or temporary

- **Long-lived or reusable:** create or reuse a project, then add a named server. Projects persist across Portly launches and belong in the sidebar.
- **Small or one-off:** run `id=$(portly temp '<command>' --name <name> --path <folder> --timeout 30m)`, then `portly wait "$id"`. `temp` returns immediately; Portly supervises the whole background process group, captures logs and resource use, and kills it at the timeout. Completed metadata remains available for one hour but is never written to `config.json` or restored after relaunch.

Do not create a permanent project merely to host a build, test, quick preview, generated artifact, throwaway demo, or short verification server. A temporary job is still managed by Portly; never add shell backgrounding around it. Use `portly logs <id>` while it runs, `portly wait <id>` for its terminal result, and expect exit code `124` when its timeout is reached.

## Memory guard

Run `portly memory-limit` to inspect the effective policy. The global value is a default applied separately to every project, not a cap on all Portly processes combined. Configure it with `portly memory-limit 5GB` or disable it with `portly memory-limit off`.

Projects inherit the global value by default. Override one with `portly memory-limit 3GB --project <project>`, exempt it with `portly memory-limit off --project <project>`, or restore inheritance with `portly memory-limit inherit --project <project>`. `GB`, `Go`, `MB`, and `Mo` are accepted.

Portly evaluates total project footprint every two seconds. Three consecutive samples above the effective limit restart every running server in that project, then sampling starts fresh on the replacement processes. Configure these policies in Settings → Memory. Never enable or lower a memory limit without the user's authorization: changing it can restart active workloads.

## Add and verify a server

1. Confirm the project path and dev command from the repository.
2. Ensure the repository's root `AGENTS.md` contains the durable Portly rule above.
3. Register the project only if absent.
4. Check the intended port with `portly port <port> --json`.
5. Add it with `portly add-server --project <project> --name <name> --command '<command>' --port <port> --start --json`.
6. Poll `portly status --json` until `running` and `healthy`.
7. Verify the meaningful URL and inspect `portly logs <project/server> --tail 100 --json`.

Register projects with `portly add-project --name <name> --path <absolute-path> --icon <sf-symbol> --color '<hex>' --json`.

Portly injects `PORT`, `PORTLY=1`, and `PORTLY_SERVER`. The configured port drives health checks; a process that does not listen there will not become healthy.

## Operate and diagnose

Use `start`, `stop`, or `restart` with a server, or `--project <project>`. `portly stop --all --json` stops everything. Use `update-server` to change fields, then restart a running server.

For repeatable maintenance that must not restart the managed server, configure an action and run it as a supervised temporary job:

```bash
portly update-server <project/server> --action 'clear-cache=trash .next/cache'
job_id="$(portly action <project/server> clear-cache)"
portly wait "$job_id"
```

Actions inherit the server's working directory, environment, `PORT`, and original `PORTLY_SERVER`. Use an application endpoint or another framework-supported command for in-memory caches; removing a disk cache cannot clear state already held by the live process.

Inspect conflicts with `portly port <port> --json`. Use `portly kill-port <port> --json` only when the stop is requested or the occupant is confirmed in scope. Portly sends SIGTERM to regular processes and, for a Docker-published port, resolves and stops only the publishing container. It never auto-stops conflicts or signals Docker Desktop's global backend.

When a configured server's port is held by a process launched elsewhere, use `portly take-over <project/server> --json` (alias: `adopt`). Portly safely stops the process or publishing Docker container, waits for the port to be released, then starts the configured command itself. Never take over an unknown workload without confirming it is in scope.

Keep proof distinct: `status` proves Portly state, `logs` proves captured child output, `port` proves a listener, and `curl` proves the meaningful route responds.

## Remove, quit, and configure

- Remove a server: `portly remove <project/server> --json`.
- Remove a project: `portly remove --project <project> --json`.
- Show config: `portly config` or `portly config --path-only`.
- Open the app: `portly open --json`.
- Quit: `portly quit --json`.

Removing a project stops its servers. Quitting stops every managed server because Portly is the supervisor. The source of truth is `~/.config/portly/config.json`, hot-reloaded by the app; logs are in `~/.config/portly/logs/`.

## macOS forever mode

Use `portly forever enable --json` when Portly itself must launch at every macOS login. The command transfers currently active servers to the launchd-owned app. Verify both `portly forever status --json` and `portly status --json`; launchd state alone does not prove a managed server or its meaningful route works.

Use `portly forever disable --json` to unload the LaunchAgent recoverably while keeping currently active servers under a regular Portly launch.

## Linux

On Linux, use the headless `portly` binary from this repository's `cli/` folder. It is the supervisor: commands auto-start a loopback daemon and speak the same API as macOS. Do not install `Portly.app`. `open` has no window and reports that. `forever` uses a systemd user unit, not launchd; it errors clearly when systemd is missing. Do not run the macOS app and the Linux daemon against the same `7737` port.

---
name: dev-browser
description: Browser automation with persistent page state using the dev-browser CLI. Use when the user mentions browse, open website, click, fill form, screenshot, scrape, automate browser, test website, log into, navigate, web page, or any browser interaction.
allowed-tools:
  - Bash(dev-browser *)
  - Bash(/Applications/Helium.app/Contents/MacOS/Helium *)
---

Drive every browser task with the `dev-browser` CLI. Never use Cursor IDE Browser MCP (`cursor-ide-browser`, `browser_navigate`, `browser_snapshot`, `browser_lock`, `browser_click`, `browser_cdp`, or any `browser_*` tool).

If `dev-browser` is missing: obey the repo's package-manager rules (no `npm install -g` when npm is forbidden). In Codex, prefer the bundled Node/Playwright/Chromium runtime for page-load, screenshot, console, and interaction checks. Install the CLI only when npm is allowed and the task needs persistence or CDP the bundled runtime cannot provide: `npm install -g dev-browser && dev-browser install`. When falling back to Playwright, keep the same proof (URL, title, errors, screenshots, exact steps) and state that the CLI was unavailable.

Write one-thing scripts. Reuse named pages (`browser.getPage("main")`) across runs. End each script by logging JSON state. Commands, flags, Page methods, locators, screenshots, forms, and CDP connect: [api-reference.md](references/api-reference.md). Open that file before inventing a Page method.

File I/O is only `~/.dev-browser/tmp/`. Never pass absolute paths to `saveScreenshot` or `writeFile`; copy out from the returned tmp path.

Helium is not auto-discovered. Launch it with `--remote-debugging-port` and connect with `dev-browser --browser helium --connect http://127.0.0.1:<port>`. An already-running Helium without CDP cannot be attached; if it must not restart, use AppleScript or Computer Use.

On script failure, the page stays put. Reconnect, screenshot, log URL/title, then continue.

+import { C, World } from './world'
+import { PRESETS, STRUCTURAL_KEYS, presetParams, type Params } from './params'
+
+export const SPEEDS = [0.5, 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32]
+
+const MAX_FRAME = 0.1
+const BUDGET_MS = 14
+
+export class Runner {
+  world: World
+  staged: Params
+  presetId = 'balanced'
+  playing = true
+  speed = 4
+  alpha = 1
+  frameSpeed = 1
+
+  private acc = 0
+  private stepUntil = -1
+  private lastTickCost = 0
+
+  constructor(params: Params) {
+    this.staged = { ...params }
+    this.world = new World(params)
+    this.world.emit = true
+  }
+
+  get pendingRestart(): boolean {
+    for (const k of STRUCTURAL_KEYS) if (this.staged[k] !== this.world.params[k]) return true
+    return false
+  }
+
+  get stepping(): boolean {
+    return this.stepUntil >= 0
+  }
+
+  setParam<K extends keyof Params>(key: K, value: Params[K]) {
+    this.staged[key] = value
+    if (!STRUCTURAL_KEYS.includes(key)) this.world.params[key] = value
+  }
+
+  reset() {
+    this.world.reset({ ...this.staged })
+    this.world.emit = true
+    this.acc = 0
+    this.alpha = 1
+    this.stepUntil = -1
+  }
+
+  loadPreset(id: string) {
+    const preset = PRESETS.find((p) => p.id === id)
+    if (!preset) return
+    this.presetId = id
+    const keepSeed = this.staged.seed
+    this.staged = { ...presetParams(id), seed: keepSeed }
+    this.reset()
+  }
+
+  randomize(rand: () => number = Math.random) {
+    const p = { ...this.staged }
+    const jitter = (v: number, spread: number, lo: number, hi: number) =>
+      Math.min(hi, Math.max(lo, v * (1 + (rand() * 2 - 1) * spread)))
+    p.seed = Math.floor(rand() * 9999) + 1
+    p.fruitGrowth = +jitter(p.fruitGrowth, 0.3, 0.03, 0.3).toFixed(3)
+    p.fruitLimit = Math.round(jitter(p.fruitLimit, 0.3, 2, 12))
+    p.blueSpeed = +jitter(p.blueSpeed, 0.15, 1.2, 4).toFixed(2)
+    p.blueVision = +jitter(p.blueVision, 0.2, 4, 14).toFixed(1)
+    p.redSpeed = +jitter(p.redSpeed, 0.12, 1.5, 4.5).toFixed(2)
+    p.redVision = +jitter(p.redVision, 0.2, 4, 14).toFixed(1)
+    p.redStrength = Math.round(jitter(p.redStrength, 0.22, 8, 45))
+    p.redPause = +jitter(p.redPause, 0.3, 1.5, 8).toFixed(1)
+    p.trees = Math.round(jitter(p.trees, 0.25, 6, 30))
+    p.startBlue = Math.round(jitter(p.startBlue, 0.3, 20, 160))
+    p.startRed = Math.round(jitter(p.startRed, 0.4, 3, 40))
+    this.presetId = 'custom'
+    this.staged = p
+    this.reset()
+  }
+
+  play() {
+    this.playing = true
+    this.stepUntil = -1
+  }
+
+  pause() {
+    this.playing = false
+    this.stepUntil = -1
+  }
+
+  toggle() {
+    if (this.playing) this.pause()
+    else this.play()
+  }
+
+  stepOnce(seconds = 1) {
+    this.playing = false
+    this.stepUntil = this.world.t + seconds
+  }
+
+  setSpeed(s: number) {
+    this.speed = s
+  }
+
+  /** Advances the simulation by real elapsed seconds. Returns ticks executed. */
+  frame(dtReal: number): number {
+    const running = this.playing || this.stepUntil >= 0
+    if (!running) {
+      this.frameSpeed = 0
+      return 0
+    }
+    const dt = Math.min(dtReal, MAX_FRAME)
+    this.acc += dt * this.speed
+    this.frameSpeed = this.speed
+    const t0 = performance.now()
+    let steps = 0
+    const w = this.world
+    while (this.acc >= C.DT) {
+      w.step()
+      this.acc -= C.DT
+      steps++
+      if (this.stepUntil >= 0 && w.t >= this.stepUntil) {
+        this.stepUntil = -1
+        this.acc = 0
+        break
+      }
+      if ((steps & 7) === 0 && performance.now() - t0 > BUDGET_MS) {
+        this.acc = 0
+        break
+      }
+    }
+    this.lastTickCost = performance.now() - t0
+    this.alpha = this.stepUntil >= 0 || this.playing ? Math.min(1, this.acc / C.DT) : 1
+    return steps
+  }
+
+  get cost() {
+    return this.lastTickCost
+  }
+}

+import type { Sample, World } from './world'
+import { correlationLag, findPeaks, smooth } from './signal'
+
+export type Mood = 'warming' | 'balanced' | 'waves' | 'small' | 'blue-only' | 'red-fading' | 'empty' | 'red-boom'
+
+export interface Summary {
+  mood: Mood
+  headline: string
+  lines: string[]
+  chips: { label: string; value: string }[]
+}
+
+export function fmtTime(t: number): string {
+  const s = Math.max(0, Math.round(t))
+  const m = Math.floor(s / 60)
+  const r = s % 60
+  return `${m}:${String(r).padStart(2, '0')}`
+}
+
+function argmax(a: number[]): number {
+  let bi = 0
+  for (let i = 1; i < a.length; i++) if (a[i] > a[bi]) bi = i
+  return bi
+}
+
+function argmin(a: number[], from = 0): number {
+  let bi = from
+  for (let i = from + 1; i < a.length; i++) if (a[i] < a[bi]) bi = i
+  return bi
+}
+
+function mean(a: number[]): number {
+  return a.length ? a.reduce((x, y) => x + y, 0) / a.length : 0
+}
+
+function stdev(a: number[]): number {
+  if (a.length < 2) return 0
+  const m = mean(a)
+  return Math.sqrt(mean(a.map((v) => (v - m) * (v - m))))
+}
+
+export function summarize(world: World): Summary {
+  const h: Sample[] = world.history
+  const p = world.params
+  const t = world.t
+  const chips: Summary['chips'] = [
+    { label: 'Garden time', value: fmtTime(t) },
+    { label: 'Fruit eaten', value: String(world.stats.fruitEaten) },
+    { label: 'Contacts', value: String(world.stats.contacts) },
+    { label: 'Blue born', value: String(world.stats.blueBorn) },
+    { label: 'Red born', value: String(world.stats.redBorn) },
+  ]
+
+  if (h.length < 10 || t < 25) {
+    return {
+      mood: 'warming',
+      headline: 'The garden is just waking up.',
+      lines: ['Press play and let a few minutes of garden time pass. The story is written from what actually happens.'],
+      chips,
+    }
+  }
+
+  const dt = h.length > 1 ? (h[h.length - 1].t - h[0].t) / (h.length - 1) : 1
+  const blue = h.map((s) => s.blue)
+  const red = h.map((s) => s.red)
+  const fruit = h.map((s) => s.fruit)
+  const sw = Math.max(3, Math.round(12 / dt) | 1)
+  const bs = smooth(blue, sw)
+  const rs = smooth(red, sw)
+
+  const maxBlue = Math.max(...blue)
+  const maxRed = Math.max(...red)
+  const lastHalf = Math.floor(h.length / 2)
+  const lateBlue = bs.slice(lastHalf)
+  const lateRed = rs.slice(lastHalf)
+  const meanBlue = mean(lateBlue)
+  const meanRed = mean(lateRed)
+  const meanFruit = mean(fruit.slice(lastHalf))
+  const fruitCap = Math.max(1, p.trees * p.fruitLimit)
+  const fruitFill = meanFruit / fruitCap
+
+  const bPeaks = findPeaks(bs, Math.max(5, meanBlue * 0.35))
+  const rPeaks = findPeaks(rs, Math.max(2, meanRed * 0.35))
+  const bp0 = bPeaks.length ? bPeaks[0].index : argmax(bs)
+  const rp0 = rPeaks.length ? rPeaks[0].index : argmax(rs)
+
+  const maxLag = Math.max(2, Math.round(Math.min(360, t / 2) / dt))
+  const lag = correlationLag(bs, rs, maxLag)
+  const lagSec = Math.round(lag.lag * dt)
+
+  const blueAlive = world.blueCount > 0
+  const redAlive = world.redCount > 0
+  const lines: string[] = []
+
+  const chipsOut = chips.slice()
+  chipsOut.push({ label: 'Blue peaks', value: String(bPeaks.length) })
+  chipsOut.push({ label: 'Red peaks', value: String(rPeaks.length) })
+
+  let mood: Mood
+  let headline: string
+
+  if (!blueAlive && !redAlive) {
+    mood = 'empty'
+    headline = 'Both groups faded. Only the trees remain.'
+    lines.push(
+      `Blue reached ${maxBlue} and red reached ${maxRed} before everyone ran out of energy at ${fmtTime(lastAlive(h))}.`,
+    )
+    lines.push('Once blue was gone, red had nothing to draw energy from and faded too.')
+  } else if (!blueAlive) {
+    mood = 'red-fading'
+    headline = 'Blue faded, so red is running on empty.'
+    lines.push(
+      `Blue peaked at ${maxBlue} around ${fmtTime(h[argmax(blue)].t)} and disappeared. ${world.redCount} red blob${world.redCount === 1 ? '' : 's'} left, with nothing to get energy from.`,
+    )
+    lines.push('Fruit is piling up on the trees because nobody is eating it.')
+  } else if (!redAlive) {
+    mood = 'blue-only'
+    headline = 'One group faded and the world settled into a simpler state.'
+    lines.push(
+      `Red peaked at ${maxRed} around ${fmtTime(h[argmax(red)].t)}, then faded when blue got too scarce to feed it.`,
+    )
+    lines.push(
+      `Blue now grows against the fruit supply alone, near ${Math.round(meanBlue)} blobs with fruit on the trees averaging ${Math.round(meanFruit)}.`,
+    )
+  } else if (meanBlue / Math.max(1, p.trees) < 1.5 && fruitFill < 0.45) {
+    mood = 'small'
+    headline = 'Low fruit kept the garden small.'
+    lines.push(
+      `Blue stays around ${Math.round(meanBlue)} and red around ${Math.round(meanRed)}. Trees hold about ${Math.round(meanFruit)} of ${fruitCap} possible fruit, so there is not enough energy to grow much.`,
+    )
+  } else if (bPeaks.length >= 2 && rPeaks.length >= 2) {
+    mood = 'waves'
+    headline = 'Waves are rolling: blue surges, then red follows.'
+    lines.push(
+      `Blue has peaked ${bPeaks.length} times and red ${rPeaks.length} times. Each red surge trails a blue surge${lag.lag > 0 && lag.corr > 0.15 ? ` by roughly ${lagSec} s of garden time` : ''}.`,
+    )
+  } else {
+    const cv = stdev(lateBlue) / Math.max(1, meanBlue)
+    if (cv < 0.35) {
+      mood = 'balanced'
+      headline = 'The garden stayed balanced.'
+      lines.push(
+        `Blue hovers near ${Math.round(meanBlue)} and red near ${Math.round(meanRed)}. Fruit eaten, energy drained and new blobs roughly cancel out.`,
+      )
+    } else {
+      mood = 'red-boom'
+      headline = 'Big swings, and the waves are still forming.'
+      lines.push(
+        `Blue has ranged from ${Math.min(...lateBlue).toFixed(0)} to ${Math.max(...lateBlue).toFixed(0)} while red drifts near ${Math.round(meanRed)}.`,
+      )
+    }
+  }
+
+  if (blueAlive || redAlive) {
+    if (bp0 < rp0 && maxBlue > 0 && maxRed > 0) {
+      lines.push(
+        `Blue grew first, peaking at ${maxBlue > 0 ? Math.round(bs[bp0]) : 0} around ${fmtTime(h[bp0].t)}. Red followed and peaked at ${Math.round(rs[rp0])} around ${fmtTime(h[rp0].t)}.`,
+      )
+    } else if (rp0 <= bp0 && bPeaks.length + rPeaks.length > 0) {
+      lines.push(
+        `Red got its first crest at ${fmtTime(h[rp0].t)} while blue crested at ${fmtTime(h[bp0].t)}, so the two groups started out close together.`,
+      )
+    }
+    const bLow = argmin(bs, bp0)
+    if (bLow > bp0 && bs[bp0] - bs[bLow] > 0.3 * bs[bp0] && blueAlive) {
+      lines.push(
+        `After its crest, blue dipped to ${Math.round(bs[bLow])} around ${fmtTime(h[bLow].t)} while red held ${Math.round(rs[bLow])}. Fruit then recovered to ${Math.round(fruit[Math.min(fruit.length - 1, bLow + Math.round(30 / dt))])}.`,
+      )
+    }
+  }
+
+  if (world.stats.contacts > 0) {
+    lines.push(
+      `Red made ${world.stats.contacts} contacts and moved ${Math.round(world.stats.energyDrained)} energy from blue to red. Blue ate ${world.stats.fruitEaten} fruit.`,
+    )
+  }
+
+  const gene = world.history[world.history.length - 1]
+  if (gene && blueAlive && p.mutation > 0 && t > 200) {
+    const b0 = h.find((s) => s.blue > 0)
+    if (b0 && Math.abs(gene.blueSpeed - b0.blueSpeed) / Math.max(0.1, b0.blueSpeed) > 0.08) {
+      lines.push(
+        `Blue traits are drifting: average speed moved from ${b0.blueSpeed.toFixed(2)} to ${gene.blueSpeed.toFixed(2)}, vision from ${b0.blueVision.toFixed(1)} to ${gene.blueVision.toFixed(1)}.`,
+      )
+    }
+  }
+
+  return { mood, headline, lines: lines.slice(0, 5), chips: chipsOut }
+}
+
+function lastAlive(h: Sample[]): number {
+  for (let i = h.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) if (h[i].blue + h[i].red > 0) return h[i].t
+  return 0
+}

import type { Params } from '../sim/params'

export type Tone = 'green' | 'blue' | 'red' | 'violet' | 'sand'

export interface ControlDef {
  key: keyof Params
  label: string
  min: number
  max: number
  step: number
  hint: string
  format: (v: number) => string
}

export interface ControlGroup {
  id: string
  title: string
  tone: Tone
  emoji: string
  restart?: boolean
  controls: ControlDef[]
}

const num = (digits: number, unit = '') => (v: number) => `${v.toFixed(digits)}${unit}`

export const CONTROL_GROUPS: ControlGroup[] = [
  {
    id: 'fruit',
    title: 'Fruit trees',
    tone: 'green',
    emoji: '🍏',
    controls: [
      {
        key: 'fruitGrowth',
        label: 'Fruit growth speed',
        min: 0.02,
        max: 0.4,
        step: 0.01,
        hint: 'How quickly a tree grows the next fruit.',
        format: (v) => `1 per ${(1 / v).toFixed(1)}s`,
      },
      {
        key: 'fruitLimit',

+import { useEffect, useRef, useState, type RefObject } from 'react'
+import type { Sample } from '../sim/world'
+
+export function useWidth<T extends HTMLElement>(fallback = 480): [RefObject<T | null>, number] {
+  const ref = useRef<T | null>(null)
+  const [w, setW] = useState(fallback)
+  useEffect(() => {
+    const el = ref.current
+    if (!el) return
+    const measure = () => setW(Math.max(160, Math.floor(el.clientWidth)))
+    measure()
+    const obs = new ResizeObserver(measure)
+    obs.observe(el)
+    return () => obs.disconnect()
+  }, [])
+  return [ref, w]
+}
+
+export function niceCeil(v: number): number {
+  if (v <= 0) return 1
+  const e = Math.pow(10, Math.floor(Math.log10(v)))
+  const f = v / e
+  const n = f <= 1 ? 1 : f <= 2 ? 2 : f <= 2.5 ? 2.5 : f <= 5 ? 5 : 10
+  return n * e
+}
+
+export function niceTimeStep(span: number, target: number): number {
+  const steps = [5, 10, 15, 30, 60, 120, 180, 300, 600, 900, 1800, 3600, 7200]
+  const want = span / target
+  for (const s of steps) if (s >= want) return s
+  return steps[steps.length - 1]
+}
+
+export function fmtClock(t: number): string {
+  const s = Math.max(0, Math.round(t))
+  const m = Math.floor(s / 60)
+  return `${m}:${String(s % 60).padStart(2, '0')}`
+}
+
+export function decimate(h: Sample[], from: number, maxPoints: number): Sample[] {
+  let start = 0
+  if (from > 0) {
+    let lo = 0
+    let hi = h.length
+    while (lo < hi) {
+      const mid = (lo + hi) >> 1
+      if (h[mid].t < from) lo = mid + 1
+      else hi = mid
+    }
+    start = Math.max(0, lo - 1)
+  }
+  const n = h.length - start
+  if (n <= maxPoints) return h.slice(start)
+  const stride = Math.ceil(n / maxPoints)
+  const out: Sample[] = []
+  for (let i = start; i < h.length; i += stride) out.push(h[i])
+  const last = h[h.length - 1]
+  if (out[out.length - 1] !== last) out.push(last)
+  return out
+}
+
+export function linePath(pts: [number, number][]): string {
+  if (!pts.length) return ''
+  let d = `M${pts[0][0].toFixed(1)},${pts[0][1].toFixed(1)}`
+  for (let i = 1; i < pts.length; i++) d += `L${pts[i][0].toFixed(1)},${pts[i][1].toFixed(1)}`
+  return d
+}
+
+export function areaPath(pts: [number, number][], baseY: number): string {
+  if (!pts.length) return ''
+  return `${linePath(pts)}L${pts[pts.length - 1][0].toFixed(1)},${baseY}L${pts[0][0].toFixed(1)},${baseY}Z`
+}

+    s.onPick = (id) => cb.current.onPick(id)
+    let raf = 0
+    let last = performance.now()
+    let uiClock = 0
+    const loop = (now: number) => {
+      const dt = Math.min(0.1, Math.max(0, (now - last) / 1000))
+      last = now
+      runner.frame(dt)
+      s.update(runner.world, runner.alpha, dt, runner.frameSpeed)
+      uiClock += dt
+      if (uiClock >= 0.2) {
+        uiClock = 0
+        cb.current.onFrame()
+      }
+      raf = requestAnimationFrame(loop)
+    }
+    raf = requestAnimationFrame(loop)
+    return () => {
+      cancelAnimationFrame(raf)
+      onScene?.(null)
+      s.dispose()
+      scene.current = null
+    }
+    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
+  }, [runner])
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    scene.current?.select(selectedId)
+  }, [selectedId])
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    scene.current?.setFollow(follow)
+  }, [follow])
+
+  return <div ref={host} className="garden-canvas" />
+}

import * as THREE from 'three'
import { OrbitControls } from 'three/examples/jsm/controls/OrbitControls.js'
import { RoomEnvironment } from 'three/examples/jsm/environments/RoomEnvironment.js'
import { BLUE, C, type Blob, type Tree, type World } from '../sim/world'
import { hashUnit } from '../sim/rng'
import {
  BROW_CENTER,
  CHEEK_L,
  CHEEK_R,
  EYE_CENTER,
  MOUTH_POS,
  makeBeanGeometry,
  makeBrowsGeometry,
  makeCanopyGeometry,
  makeCheekGeometry,
  makeDishGeometry,
  makeEyesGeometry,
  makeFlowerGeometry,
  makeFruitGeometry,
  makeGrassTexture,
  makeMouthOpenGeometry,
  makeRingTexture,
  makeRockGeometry,
  makeSmileGeometry,
  makeSoftDiscTexture,
  makeTrunkGeometry,
  makeTuftGeometry,
} from './geometry'
import { KIND_DOT, KIND_RING, KIND_STAR, Particles } from './particles'

const BLOB_CAP = C.MAX_BLUE + C.MAX_RED + 60
const SLOTS = C.MAX_SLOTS
const LUMPS = 4

const BLUE_COLOR = new THREE.Color('#3f9bff')
const RED_COLOR = new THREE.Color('#ff4f66')
const GRAY = new THREE.Color('#9aa3b8')
const WHITE = new THREE.Color('#ffffff')

interface Vis {
  lastX: number
  lastZ: number
  rx: number
  rz: number
  heading: number
  speed: number
  phase: number
  blinkIn: number
  blinkT: number
  happy: number
  shock: number
  wobble: number
  prevHeading: number
  roll: number
  seen: number
}

interface Lump {
  x: number
  y: number
  z: number
  r: number
}

const tmpM = new THREE.Matrix4()
const tmpM2 = new THREE.Matrix4()
const bodyM = new THREE.Matrix4()
const q = new THREE.Quaternion()
const q2 = new THREE.Quaternion()
const eul = new THREE.Euler()
const vp = new THREE.Vector3()
const vs = new THREE.Vector3()
const ONE = new THREE.Vector3(1, 1, 1)
const IDQ = new THREE.Quaternion()
const col = new THREE.Color()
const AXIS_Y = new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0)

const clamp = (v: number, a: number, b: number) => Math.min(b, Math.max(a, v))
const easeOutBack = (t: number) => {
  const c1 = 1.9
  const c3 = c1 + 1
  return 1 + c3 * Math.pow(t - 1, 3) + c1 * Math.pow(t - 1, 2)
}

function angleLerp(a: number, b: number, t: number): number {
  let d = b - a
  while (d > Math.PI) d -= Math.PI * 2
  while (d < -Math.PI) d += Math.PI * 2
  return a + d * t
}

export class GardenScene {
  readonly renderer: THREE.WebGLRenderer
  readonly scene = new THREE.Scene()
  readonly camera: THREE.PerspectiveCamera
  readonly controls: OrbitControls
  onPick: (id: number | null) => void = () => {}
  onInteract: () => void = () => {}

  private container: HTMLElement
  private world: World | null = null
  private radius = 26
  private time = 0
  private staticGroup = new THREE.Group()
  private light: THREE.DirectionalLight
  private particles = new Particles(1800)
  private vis = new Map<number, Vis>()
  private selectedId: number | null = null
  private hoverId: number | null = null
  private follow = false
  private lastFruit: number[] = []
  private lastWorldT = 0
  private gcTimer = 0
  private resizeObs: ResizeObserver
  private downX = 0
  private downY = 0
  private downT = 0
  private lastHoverCheck = 0

  private bodies!: THREE.InstancedMesh
  private eyes!: THREE.InstancedMesh
  private brows!: THREE.InstancedMesh
  private smiles!: THREE.InstancedMesh
  private mouths!: THREE.InstancedMesh
  private cheeks!: THREE.InstancedMesh
  private shadows!: THREE.InstancedMesh
  private glows!: THREE.InstancedMesh
  private held!: THREE.InstancedMesh

  private trunks: THREE.InstancedMesh | null = null
  private canopies: THREE.InstancedMesh | null = null
  private fruits: THREE.InstancedMesh | null = null
  private treeLumps: Lump[][] = []
  private treeSlots: THREE.Vector3[][] = []
  private treeVis = new Float32Array(0)
  private treeWobble = new Float32Array(0)

  private selRing: THREE.Mesh
  private selArrow: THREE.Mesh
  private visionRing: THREE.Mesh
  private hoverRing: THREE.Mesh
  private ringTex = makeRingTexture()
  private shadowTex = makeSoftDiscTexture()

  constructor(container: HTMLElement) {
    this.container = container
    this.renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true, alpha: true, powerPreference: 'high-performance' })
    this.renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2))
    this.renderer.setClearColor(0x000000, 0)
    this.renderer.shadowMap.enabled = true
    this.renderer.shadowMap.type = THREE.PCFSoftShadowMap
    this.renderer.toneMapping = THREE.NeutralToneMapping
    this.renderer.toneMappingExposure = 1.05
    const el = this.renderer.domElement
    el.style.width = '100%'
    el.style.height = '100%'
    el.style.display = 'block'
    el.style.touchAction = 'none'
    container.appendChild(el)

    this.camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(36, 1, 0.5, 400)
    this.controls = new OrbitControls(this.camera, el)
    this.controls.enablePan = false
    this.controls.enableDamping = true
    this.controls.dampingFactor = 0.08
    this.controls.minPolarAngle = 0.12
    this.controls.maxPolarAngle = 1.38
    this.controls.rotateSpeed = 0.7
    this.controls.zoomSpeed = 0.7
    this.controls.autoRotate = true
    this.controls.autoRotateSpeed = 0.55
    this.controls.addEventListener('start', () => {
      this.controls.autoRotate = false
      this.onInteract()
    })

    const pmrem = new THREE.PMREMGenerator(this.renderer)
    this.scene.environment = pmrem.fromScene(new RoomEnvironment(), 0.04).texture
    this.scene.environmentIntensity = 0.5
    pmrem.dispose()

    const hemi = new THREE.HemisphereLight('#fff5df', '#bcd3ff', 1.15)
    this.scene.add(hemi)
    this.light = new THREE.DirectionalLight('#fff0d6', 2.6)
    this.light.castShadow = true
    this.light.shadow.mapSize.set(2048, 2048)
    this.light.shadow.bias = -0.0004
    this.light.shadow.normalBias = 0.05
    this.scene.add(this.light)
    this.scene.add(this.light.target)

    this.scene.add(this.staticGroup)
    this.buildBlobMeshes()
    this.scene.add(this.particles.points)

    const ringMat = (color: string, opacity: number) =>
      new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color, transparent: true, opacity, depthWrite: false, side: THREE.DoubleSide, map: this.ringTex })
    const flat = (geo: THREE.BufferGeometry) => {
      geo.rotateX(-Math.PI / 2)
      return geo
    }
    this.selRing = new THREE.Mesh(flat(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(2.6, 2.6)), ringMat('#ffffff', 0.95))
    this.selRing.renderOrder = 5
    this.selRing.visible = false
    this.scene.add(this.selRing)
    this.hoverRing = new THREE.Mesh(flat(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(2.2, 2.2)), ringMat('#ffffff', 0.55))
    this.hoverRing.renderOrder = 4
    this.hoverRing.visible = false
    this.scene.add(this.hoverRing)
    this.visionRing = new THREE.Mesh(
      flat(new THREE.RingGeometry(0.985, 1, 128)),
      new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: '#ffffff', transparent: true, opacity: 0.7, depthWrite: false, side: THREE.DoubleSide }),
    )
    this.visionRing.renderOrder = 3
    this.visionRing.visible = false
    this.scene.add(this.visionRing)
    const arrow = new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.28, 0.55, 4)
    arrow.rotateX(Math.PI)
    this.selArrow = new THREE.Mesh(arrow, new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: '#ffffff' }))
    this.selArrow.visible = false
    this.scene.add(this.selArrow)

    this.resizeObs = new ResizeObserver(() => this.resize())
    this.resizeObs.observe(container)
    this.resize()

    el.addEventListener('pointerdown', this.onDown)
    el.addEventListener('pointerup', this.onUp)
    el.addEventListener('pointermove', this.onMove)
    el.addEventListener('pointerleave', this.onLeave)
  }

  private buildBlobMeshes() {
    const bodyMat = new THREE.MeshPhysicalMaterial({
      color: '#ffffff',
      roughness: 0.26,
      metalness: 0,
      clearcoat: 1,
      clearcoatRoughness: 0.12,
      sheen: 0.4,
      sheenColor: new THREE.Color('#ffffff'),
      sheenRoughness: 0.5,
    })
    const mk = (geo: THREE.BufferGeometry, mat: THREE.Material, cast = false, count = BLOB_CAP) => {
      const m = new THREE.InstancedMesh(geo, mat, count)
      m.instanceMatrix.setUsage(THREE.DynamicDrawUsage)
      m.frustumCulled = false
      m.castShadow = cast
      m.count = 0
      this.scene.add(m)
      return m
    }
    this.bodies = mk(makeBeanGeometry(), bodyMat, true)
    this.bodies.receiveShadow = true
    this.bodies.instanceColor = new THREE.InstancedBufferAttribute(new Float32Array(BLOB_CAP * 3), 3)
    this.bodies.instanceColor.setUsage(THREE.DynamicDrawUsage)

    const faceMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ vertexColors: true, roughness: 0.3, metalness: 0 })
    this.eyes = mk(makeEyesGeometry(), faceMat)
    this.brows = mk(makeBrowsGeometry(), new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ vertexColors: true, roughness: 0.6 }))
    this.smiles = mk(makeSmileGeometry(), new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ vertexColors: true, roughness: 0.6 }))
    this.mouths = mk(makeMouthOpenGeometry(), new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ vertexColors: true, roughness: 0.5 }))
    this.cheeks = mk(makeCheekGeometry(), new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: '#ff8fae', roughness: 0.7 }))

    const flatDisc = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(1, 1)
    flatDisc.rotateX(-Math.PI / 2)
    this.shadows = mk(
      flatDisc,
      new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ map: this.shadowTex, transparent: true, depthWrite: false, polygonOffset: true, polygonOffsetFactor: -2 }),
    )
    this.shadows.renderOrder = 1

    const glowGeo = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(1, 1)
    glowGeo.rotateX(-Math.PI / 2)
    this.glows = mk(
      glowGeo,
      new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ map: this.ringTex, transparent: true, depthWrite: false, blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending }),
    )
    this.glows.instanceColor = new THREE.InstancedBufferAttribute(new Float32Array(BLOB_CAP * 3), 3)
    this.glows.instanceColor.setUsage(THREE.DynamicDrawUsage)
    this.glows.renderOrder = 2

    this.held = mk(
      makeFruitGeometry(),
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ vertexColors: true, roughness: 0.35 }),
      false,
      256,
    )
  }

  setWorld(world: World) {
    this.world = world
    this.radius = world.radius
    this.rebuildStatic()
    this.vis.clear()
    this.particles.clear()
    this.lastFruit = world.trees.map((t) => t.fruit)
    this.lastWorldT = world.t
    this.selectedId = null
    this.selRing.visible = false
    this.selArrow.visible = false
    this.visionRing.visible = false
    this.hoverRing.visible = false
    this.fitCamera(true)
  }

  fitCamera(keepAngles: boolean) {
    const R = this.radius
    const dist = R * 2.55
    if (keepAngles && this.camera.position.lengthSq() > 1) {
      const dir = this.camera.position.clone().sub(this.controls.target).normalize()
      this.camera.position.copy(dir.multiplyScalar(dist))
    } else {
      this.camera.position.set(0, dist * 0.7, dist * 0.74)
    }
    this.controls.target.set(0, 0, 0)
    this.controls.minDistance = R * 0.7
    this.controls.maxDistance = R * 4.4
    this.controls.update()
  }

  private disposeGroup(g: THREE.Group) {
    g.traverse((o) => {
      const m = o as THREE.Mesh
      if (m.geometry) m.geometry.dispose()
      const mat = m.material as THREE.Material | THREE.Material[] | undefined
      if (Array.isArray(mat)) mat.forEach((x) => x.dispose())
      else if (mat) {
        const mm = mat as THREE.MeshStandardMaterial
        if (mm.map) mm.map.dispose()
        mat.dispose()
      }
    })
    g.clear()
  }

  private rebuildStatic() {
    const world = this.world!
    const R = this.radius
    this.disposeGroup(this.staticGroup)
    this.trunks = this.canopies = this.fruits = null

    const L = R + 30
    this.light.position.set(-0.55 * L, 1.0 * L, 0.5 * L)
    this.light.target.position.set(0, 0, 0)
    const sc = this.light.shadow.camera
    const half = R + 6
    sc.left = -half
    sc.right = half
    sc.top = half
    sc.bottom = -half
    sc.near = 5
    sc.far = L * 2.4
    sc.updateProjectionMatrix()
    this.light.shadow.map?.dispose()
    this.light.shadow.map = null

    const grassTex = makeGrassTexture()
    const grass = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.CircleGeometry(R, 128),
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ map: grassTex, roughness: 0.95 }),
    )
    grass.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2
    grass.position.y = 0.02
    grass.receiveShadow = true
    this.staticGroup.add(grass)

    const { body, lip } = makeDishGeometry(R)
    const dish = new THREE.Mesh(body, new THREE.MeshPhysicalMaterial({ color: '#f6dfbd', roughness: 0.42, clearcoat: 0.6, clearcoatRoughness: 0.3, side: THREE.DoubleSide }))
    dish.castShadow = true
    dish.receiveShadow = true
    this.staticGroup.add(dish)
    const lipMesh = new THREE.Mesh(lip, new THREE.MeshPhysicalMaterial({ color: '#ffe9c9', roughness: 0.35, clearcoat: 0.7 }))
    lipMesh.castShadow = true
    lipMesh.receiveShadow = true
    this.staticGroup.add(lipMesh)
    const soil = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.TorusGeometry(R + 0.02, 0.12, 8, 128),
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: '#8a6446', roughness: 1 }),
    )
    soil.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2
    soil.position.y = 0.04
    this.staticGroup.add(soil)

    const table = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(R * 8, R * 8), new THREE.ShadowMaterial({ opacity: 0.22 }))
    table.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2
    table.position.y = -2.72
    table.receiveShadow = true
    this.staticGroup.add(table)

    this.buildDecor(R, world)
    this.buildTrees(world)
  }

  private buildDecor(R: number, world: World) {
    const area = Math.PI * R * R
    const rnd = (i: number, k: number) => hashUnit(i * 31 + k * 7919 + 17)
    const place = (i: number, salt: number, minR = 0.5) => {
      for (let a = 0; a < 6; a++) {
        const ang = rnd(i * 7 + a, salt) * Math.PI * 2
        const rr = Math.sqrt(rnd(i * 7 + a, salt + 1)) * (R - 0.9)
        const x = Math.cos(ang) * rr
        const z = Math.sin(ang) * rr
        let ok = rr > minR
        for (const t of world.trees) {
          if (Math.hypot(t.x - x, t.y - z) < 1.7) ok = false
        }
        if (ok) return { x, z }
      }
      return null
    }

    const tuftN = Math.round(area / 5)
    const tufts = new THREE.InstancedMesh(
      makeTuftGeometry(),
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: '#6fbf52', roughness: 0.9 }),
      tuftN,
    )
    let n = 0
    for (let i = 0; i < tuftN; i++) {
      const p = place(i, 1)
      if (!p) continue
      const s = 0.7 + rnd(i, 3) * 0.8
      q.setFromAxisAngle(AXIS_Y, rnd(i, 4) * 6.28)
      tmpM.compose(vp.set(p.x, 0.02, p.z), q, vs.set(s, s * (0.8 + rnd(i, 5) * 0.6), s))
      tufts.setMatrixAt(n, tmpM)
      col.set(rnd(i, 6) > 0.5 ? '#79c95a' : '#5fae4c')
      tufts.setColorAt(n, col)
      n++
    }
    tufts.count = n
    tufts.receiveShadow = true
    this.staticGroup.add(tufts)

    const flowerN = Math.round(area / 22)
    const flowers = new THREE.InstancedMesh(
      makeFlowerGeometry(),
      new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ vertexColors: true, roughness: 0.7 }),
      flowerN,
    )
    const petal = ['#ffffff', '#ffc2d9', '#ffe27a', '#c9b6ff']
    n = 0
    for (let i = 0; i < flowerN; i++) {
      const p = place(i, 11)
      if (!p) continue
      const s = 0.8 + rnd(i, 13) * 0.6
      q.setFromAxisAngle(AXIS_Y, rnd(i, 14) * 6.28)
      tmpM.compose(vp.set(p.x, 0.02, p.z), q, vs.set(s, s, s))
      flowers.setMatrixAt(n, tmpM)
      col.set(petal[Math.floor(rnd(i, 15) * petal.length)])
      flowers.setColorAt(n, col)
      n++
    }
    flowers.count = n
    this.staticGroup.add(flowers)

    const rockN = Math.max(4, Math.round(area / 260))
    const rocks = new THREE.InstancedMesh(makeRockGeometry(), new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: '#b8b3a8', roughness: 0.85 }), rockN)
    n = 0
    for (let i = 0; i < rockN; i++) {
      const p = place(i, 21, R * 0.35)
      if (!p) continue
      const s = 0.8 + rnd(i, 23) * 1.2
      q.setFromAxisAngle(AXIS_Y, rnd(i, 24) * 6.28)
      tmpM.compose(vp.set(p.x, 0.06, p.z), q, vs.set(s, s, s))
      rocks.setMatrixAt(n, tmpM)
      n++
    }
    rocks.count = n
    rocks.castShadow = true
    rocks.receiveShadow = true
    this.staticGroup.add(rocks)
  }

  private buildTrees(world: World) {
    const nT = world.trees.length
    const canopyMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: '#ffffff', roughness: 0.78 })
    const trunkMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: '#8d5f3c', roughness: 0.9 })
    const fruitMat = new THREE.MeshPhysicalMaterial({ vertexColors: true, roughness: 0.32, clearcoat: 0.6 })
    this.trunks = new THREE.InstancedMesh(makeTrunkGeometry(), trunkMat, Math.max(1, nT))
    this.canopies = new THREE.InstancedMesh(makeCanopyGeometry(), canopyMat, Math.max(1, nT * LUMPS))
    this.fruits = new THREE.InstancedMesh(makeFruitGeometry(), fruitMat, Math.max(1, nT * SLOTS))
    for (const m of [this.trunks, this.canopies, this.fruits]) {
      m.instanceMatrix.setUsage(THREE.DynamicDrawUsage)
      m.frustumCulled = false
      this.staticGroup.add(m)
    }
    this.trunks.castShadow = true
    this.trunks.receiveShadow = true
    this.canopies.castShadow = true
    this.canopies.receiveShadow = true
    this.fruits.castShadow = false
    this.trunks.count = nT
    this.canopies.count = nT * LUMPS
    this.fruits.count = nT * SLOTS
    this.treeVis = new Float32Array(nT * SLOTS)
    this.treeWobble = new Float32Array(nT)
    this.treeLumps = []
    this.treeSlots = []

    const greens = ['#3f9d55', '#48a85a', '#3a9450', '#52b061']
    for (let i = 0; i < nT; i++) {
      const h = (k: number) => hashUnit(i * 131 + k * 17 + 5)
      const lumps: Lump[] = [
        { x: 0, y: 2.7, z: 0, r: 1.5 + h(1) * 0.2 },
        { x: 0.85 + h(2) * 0.2, y: 2.3, z: 0.3 * (h(3) - 0.5) * 2, r: 1.0 + h(4) * 0.2 },
        { x: -0.8 - h(5) * 0.2, y: 2.4, z: 0.6 * (h(6) - 0.5) * 2, r: 1.05 + h(7) * 0.2 },
        { x: 0.1 * (h(8) - 0.5), y: 3.4, z: -0.3 + 0.5 * (h(9) - 0.5), r: 0.95 + h(10) * 0.15 },
      ]
      this.treeLumps.push(lumps)
      const green = new THREE.Color(greens[i % greens.length])
      for (let j = 0; j < LUMPS; j++) {
        col.copy(green).offsetHSL((h(20 + j) - 0.5) * 0.02, 0, (h(30 + j) - 0.5) * 0.05)
        this.canopies.setColorAt(i * LUMPS + j, col)
      }
      const slots: THREE.Vector3[] = []
      for (let k = 0; k < SLOTS; k++) {
        let best: THREE.Vector3 | null = null
        for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 30 && !best; attempt++) {
          const li = Math.floor(hashUnit(i * 977 + k * 61 + attempt * 13 + 1) * LUMPS)
          const L = lumps[li]
          const th = hashUnit(i * 811 + k * 37 + attempt * 7 + 2) * Math.PI * 2
          const cy = hashUnit(i * 613 + k * 19 + attempt * 5 + 3) * 1.25 - 0.3
          const sy = Math.sqrt(1 - cy * cy)
          const dir = new THREE.Vector3(Math.cos(th) * sy, cy, Math.sin(th) * sy)
          const p = new THREE.Vector3(L.x + dir.x * L.r * 0.96, L.y + dir.y * L.r * 0.9, L.z + dir.z * L.r * 0.96)
          let inside = false
          for (let o = 0; o < LUMPS; o++) {
            if (o === li) continue
            const O = lumps[o]
            if (Math.hypot(p.x - O.x, p.y - O.y, p.z - O.z) < O.r * 0.98) inside = true
          }
          for (const s of slots) if (s.distanceTo(p) < 0.5) inside = true
          if (!inside) best = p
        }
        slots.push(best ?? new THREE.Vector3(lumps[0].x, lumps[0].y + lumps[0].r, lumps[0].z))
      }
      this.treeSlots.push(slots)
    }
    this.updateTrees(world, 0, 0)
  }

  private treeBase(t: Tree, wob: number, out: THREE.Matrix4) {
    const sway = Math.sin(this.time * 0.8 + t.id * 1.7) * 0.014
    const shake = Math.sin(this.time * 24 + t.id) * 0.05 * wob * wob
    eul.set(sway + shake, hashUnit(t.id * 3 + 1) * 6.28, sway * 0.6 + shake * 0.7, 'YXZ')
    q.setFromEuler(eul)
    const squash = 1 - 0.05 * wob
    out.compose(vp.set(t.x, 0, t.y), q, vs.set(t.scale / Math.sqrt(squash), t.scale * squash, t.scale / Math.sqrt(squash)))
  }

  private slotWorld(treeIdx: number, slot: number, out: THREE.Vector3) {
    const t = this.world!.trees[treeIdx]
    const s = this.treeSlots[treeIdx]?.[slot]
    if (!t || !s) return out.set(0, 1, 0)
    return out.set(t.x + s.x * t.scale * 0.9, s.y * t.scale, t.y + s.z * t.scale * 0.9)
  }

  private updateTrees(world: World, dt: number, _alpha: number) {
    if (!this.trunks || !this.canopies || !this.fruits) return
    const trees = world.trees
    for (let i = 0; i < trees.length; i++) {
      const t = trees[i]
      this.treeWobble[i] = Math.max(0, this.treeWobble[i] - dt * 1.8)
      const wob = this.treeWobble[i]
      this.treeBase(t, wob, tmpM)
      this.trunks.setMatrixAt(i, tmpM)
      const lumps = this.treeLumps[i]
      for (let j = 0; j < LUMPS; j++) {
        const L = lumps[j]
        tmpM2.compose(vp.set(L.x, L.y, L.z), IDQ, vs.set(L.r, L.r, L.r))
        this.canopies.setMatrixAt(i * LUMPS + j, bodyM.multiplyMatrices(tmpM, tmpM2))
      }
      const slots = this.treeSlots[i]
      for (let k = 0; k < SLOTS; k++) {
        const idx = i * SLOTS + k
        let target = 0
        if (k < t.fruit) target = 1
        else if (k === t.fruit && t.cool <= 0 && k < world.params.fruitLimit) target = 0.12 + 0.75 * Math.pow(t.progress, 0.8)
        let v = this.treeVis[idx]
        const rate = target > v ? 5 : 14
        v += (target - v) * (1 - Math.exp(-dt * rate))
        if (dt === 0) v = target
        this.treeVis[idx] = v
        const s = slots[k]
        const sc = v < 0.02 ? 0 : v
        tmpM2.compose(vp.set(s.x, s.y, s.z), IDQ, vs.set(sc, sc, sc))
        this.fruits.setMatrixAt(idx, bodyM.multiplyMatrices(tmpM, tmpM2))
        col.set('#ffffff')
      }
    }
    this.trunks.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true
    this.canopies.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true
    this.fruits.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true
    if (this.canopies.instanceColor) this.canopies.instanceColor.needsUpdate = true
  }

  private newVis(b: Blob, x: number, z: number): Vis {
    return {
      lastX: x,
      lastZ: z,
      rx: x,
      rz: z,
      heading: b.heading,
      speed: 0,
      phase: hashUnit(b.id) * 6.28,
      blinkIn: 1 + hashUnit(b.id + 3) * 4,
      blinkT: 0,
      happy: 0,
      shock: 0,
      wobble: 0,
      prevHeading: b.heading,
      roll: 0,
      seen: 0,
    }
  }

  private processEvents(world: World, speed: number) {
    const ev = world.events
    if (!ev.length) return
    const lite = speed > 10 || this.particles.load > 0.7
    const max = Math.min(ev.length, 60)
    for (let i = ev.length - max; i < ev.length; i++) {
      const e = ev[i]
      switch (e.type) {
        case 'eat': {
          this.treeWobble[e.tree] = 1
          break
        }
        case 'eatDone': {
          const v = this.vis.get(e.blob)
          const b = world.byId.get(e.blob)
          if (v) v.happy = 1
          if (b && !lite) {
            for (let k = 0; k < 6; k++) {
              const a = (k / 6) * Math.PI * 2
              this.particles.spawn({
                x: v?.rx ?? b.x,
                y: 0.9,
                z: v?.rz ?? b.y,
                vx: Math.cos(a) * 1.6,
                vy: 2.2 + Math.random() * 1.2,
                vz: Math.sin(a) * 1.6,
                life: 0.8,
                s0: 0.55,
                s1: 0.1,
                color: k % 2 ? '#ffe45c' : '#8fe35a',
                kind: KIND_STAR,
                gravity: 4,
                drag: 0.6,
              })
            }
          }
          break
        }
        case 'contact': {
          const blue = world.byId.get(e.blue)
          const red = world.byId.get(e.red)
          const vb = this.vis.get(e.blue)
          const vr = this.vis.get(e.red)
          if (vb) {
            vb.shock = 1
            vb.wobble = 1
          }
          if (vr) vr.happy = 1
          if (blue && red && !lite) {
            const bx = vb?.rx ?? blue.x
            const bz = vb?.rz ?? blue.y
            const rx = vr?.rx ?? red.x
            const rz = vr?.rz ?? red.y
            this.particles.spawn({ x: bx, y: 0.25, z: bz, life: 0.6, s0: 0.5, s1: 3.4, color: '#ff8fb3', kind: KIND_RING, alpha: 0.9 })
            const target = new THREE.Vector3(rx, 0.75, rz)
            const n = Math.min(9, 3 + Math.round(e.amount / 5))
            for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) {
              this.particles.spawn({
                x: bx,
                y: 0.7,
                z: bz,
                vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 3,
                vy: 1.5 + Math.random() * 2.2,
                vz: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 3,
                life: 0.95,
                s0: 0.42,
                s1: 0.22,
                color: k % 2 ? '#ffd23f' : '#ff7bb0',
                drag: 1.4,
                target,
                homing: 1.6,
                kind: KIND_DOT,
              })
            }
            for (let k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
              this.particles.spawn({
                x: rx,
                y: 1.2,
                z: rz,
                vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2.4,
                vy: 1.6 + Math.random(),
                vz: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2.4,
                life: 1.1,
                s0: 0.5,
                s1: 0.15,
                color: '#ff6f9c',
                kind: KIND_STAR,
                gravity: 2.5,
                drag: 0.8,
              })
            }
          }
          break
        }
        case 'birth': {
          const v = this.vis.get(e.blob)
          const b = world.byId.get(e.blob)
          const pv = this.vis.get(e.parent)
          if (pv) pv.wobble = 0.8
          if (b && !lite) {
            const x = v?.rx ?? b.x
            const z = v?.rz ?? b.y
            this.particles.spawn({ x, y: 0.15, z, life: 0.7, s0: 0.4, s1: 3.2, color: '#ffffff', kind: KIND_RING, alpha: 0.9 })
            for (let k = 0; k < 7; k++) {
              const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2
              this.particles.spawn({
                x,
                y: 0.6,
                z,
                vx: Math.cos(a) * 1.4,
                vy: 1.8 + Math.random() * 1.6,
                vz: Math.sin(a) * 1.4,
                life: 0.9,
                s0: 0.5,
                s1: 0.1,
                color: b.kind === BLUE ? '#a8dcff' : '#ffc0cb',
                kind: KIND_STAR,
                gravity: 3,
                drag: 0.5,
              })
            }
          }
          break
        }
        case 'death': {
          const b = world.byId.get(e.blob)
          const v = this.vis.get(e.blob)
          if (b && !lite) {
            const x = v?.rx ?? b.x
            const z = v?.rz ?? b.y
            for (let k = 0; k < 6; k++) {
              this.particles.spawn({
                x: x + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.5,
                y: 0.5,
                z: z + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.5,
                vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.8,
                vy: 0.8 + Math.random() * 0.8,
                vz: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.8,
                life: 1.1,
                s0: 0.6,
                s1: 1.3,
                color: '#c8d0e6',
                alpha: 0.55,
                drag: 0.8,
              })
            }
          }
          break
        }
      }
    }
  }

  update(world: World, alpha: number, dt: number, speed: number) {
    if (this.world !== world) this.setWorld(world)
    if (world.t < this.lastWorldT - 1e-6) {
      this.lastFruit = world.trees.map((t) => t.fruit)
      this.vis.clear()
    }
    this.lastWorldT = world.t
    this.time += dt
    const frameDt = Math.min(dt, 0.1)

    this.processEvents(world, speed)
    world.events.length = 0

    this.updateTrees(world, frameDt, alpha)
    this.checkRipening(world, speed)
    this.updateBlobs(world, alpha, frameDt)
    this.updateSelection(world, frameDt)
    this.ambient(frameDt)
    this.particles.update(frameDt)

    this.controls.update()
    this.renderer.render(this.scene, this.camera)
  }

  private checkRipening(world: World, speed: number) {
    const trees = world.trees
    if (this.lastFruit.length !== trees.length) this.lastFruit = trees.map((t) => t.fruit)
    for (let i = 0; i < trees.length; i++) {
      const f = trees[i].fruit
      if (f > this.lastFruit[i] && speed <= 8 && this.particles.load < 0.6) {
        this.slotWorld(i, f - 1, vp)
        for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) {
          this.particles.spawn({
            x: vp.x,
            y: vp.y,
            z: vp.z,
            vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.8,
            vy: 0.5 + Math.random() * 0.8,
            vz: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.8,
            life: 0.9,
            s0: 0.42,
            s1: 0.08,
            color: '#e9ff7a',
            kind: KIND_STAR,
            drag: 0.6,
          })
        }
      }
      this.lastFruit[i] = f
    }
  }

  private ambient(dt: number) {
    if (this.particles.load > 0.5) return
    if (Math.random() < dt * 5) {
      const a = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2
      const r = Math.sqrt(Math.random()) * this.radius * 0.95
      this.particles.spawn({
        x: Math.cos(a) * r,
        y: 0.4 + Math.random() * 3,
        z: Math.sin(a) * r,
        vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.3,
        vy: 0.15 + Math.random() * 0.25,
        vz: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.3,
        life: 5 + Math.random() * 3,
        s0: 0.16,
        s1: 0.1,
        color: '#fff7b0',
        alpha: 0.55,
      })
    }
  }

  private updateBlobs(world: World, alpha: number, dt: number) {
    const blobs = world.blobs
    const p = world.params
    let n = 0
    let heldN = 0
    const stamp = this.time
    for (let bi = 0; bi < blobs.length && n < BLOB_CAP; bi++) {
      const b = blobs[bi]
      const a = b.dead ? 1 : alpha
      const wx = b.px + (b.x - b.px) * a
      const wz = b.py + (b.y - b.py) * a
      let v = this.vis.get(b.id)
      if (!v) {
        v = this.newVis(b, wx, wz)
        this.vis.set(b.id, v)
      }
      v.seen = stamp
      const isBlue = b.kind === BLUE
      const maxSp = (isBlue ? p.blueSpeed : p.redSpeed) * b.speedGene
      if (dt > 0) {
        const d = Math.hypot(wx - v.lastX, wz - v.lastZ)
        const sp = Math.min(d / dt, maxSp * 1.5)
        v.speed += (sp - v.speed) * (1 - Math.exp(-dt * 9))
        v.heading = angleLerp(v.heading, b.heading, 1 - Math.exp(-dt * 16))
        let dh = v.heading - v.prevHeading
        while (dh > Math.PI) dh -= Math.PI * 2
        while (dh < -Math.PI) dh += Math.PI * 2
        v.roll += (clamp(-dh / dt, -6, 6) * 0.06 * clamp(v.speed / 2, 0, 1.4) - v.roll) * (1 - Math.exp(-dt * 8))
        v.prevHeading = v.heading
        v.phase += v.speed * dt * (b.action === 'flee' ? 3.3 : 2.6)
        v.happy = Math.max(0, v.happy - dt * 1.5)
        v.shock = Math.max(0, v.shock - dt * 1.1)
        v.wobble = Math.max(0, v.wobble - dt * 2.2)
        v.blinkIn -= dt
        if (v.blinkIn <= 0 && v.blinkT <= 0) {
          v.blinkT = 0.16
          v.blinkIn = 2 + hashUnit(b.id * 5 + Math.floor(this.time)) * 4.5
        }
        if (v.blinkT > 0) v.blinkT = Math.max(0, v.blinkT - dt)
      }
      v.lastX = wx
      v.lastZ = wz
      v.rx = wx
      v.rz = wz

      const moveK = clamp(v.speed / 1.3, 0, 1)
      const hopN = Math.abs(Math.sin(v.phase))
      const lowE = clamp(1 - b.energy / 26, 0, 1)
      const act = b.action
      const T = this.time

      let sy = 1 + 0.11 * (hopN - 0.4) * moveK * (1 - lowE * 0.5)
      let sx = 1 / Math.sqrt(sy)
      let hop = hopN * 0.17 * moveK * (1 - lowE * 0.6)
      const br = Math.sin(T * 2.1 + b.id) * 0.018
      sy += br
      sx -= br * 0.5

      let pitch = clamp(v.speed / 5, 0, 0.5) * 0.9
      let yawWob = 0
      let eyeY = 1
      let eyeX = 1
      let mouthOpen = 0
      let smile = 1
      let smileX = 1
      let blush = 0.7
      let glowAmt = 0
      let glowTint = WHITE
      let glowSize = 1.6
      let brightness = 1

      const eyeBlink = v.blinkT > 0 ? 1 - Math.sin((1 - v.blinkT / 0.16) * Math.PI) * 0.93 : 1
      eyeY *= eyeBlink

      switch (act) {
        case 'eat': {
          const chew = Math.sin(T * 15 + b.id) * 0.5 + 0.5
          sy -= 0.07 * chew
          sx += 0.045 * chew
          mouthOpen = 0.25 + 0.55 * chew
          smile = 0
          eyeY *= 0.55
          pitch = 0.2
          blush = 1.3
          glowAmt = 0.55
          glowTint = col.set('#ffe36e')
          glowSize = 1.8 + 0.2 * Math.sin(T * 8)
          hop = 0
          break
        }
        case 'pause': {
          const k = b.timerMax > 0 ? b.timer / b.timerMax : 0
          sy += 0.06 * Math.sin(T * 9) * k
          sx -= 0.03 * Math.sin(T * 9) * k
          eyeY *= 0.3
          smileX = 1.5
          blush = 1.7
          glowAmt = 0.4 + 0.5 * k
          glowTint = col.set('#ff5c8d')
          glowSize = 1.7 + 0.4 * Math.sin(T * 6)
          hop = Math.abs(Math.sin(T * 5)) * 0.08 * k
          brightness = 1.1
          pitch = 0
          break
        }
        case 'stunned': {
          const k = b.timerMax > 0 ? b.timer / b.timerMax : 0
          sy = 0.8 + 0.12 * (1 - k)
          sx = 1.13
          eyeY = 1.28
          eyeX = 1.12
          mouthOpen = 0.75
          smile = 0
          yawWob = Math.sin(T * 34) * 0.34 * k
          pitch = -0.15
          hop = 0
          if (Math.random() < dt * 22) {
            const ang = T * 9 + Math.random() * 6
            this.particles.spawn({
              x: wx + Math.cos(ang) * 0.5,
              y: 1.05 + Math.sin(ang * 0.5) * 0.06,
              z: wz + Math.sin(ang) * 0.5,
              life: 0.35,
              s0: 0.3,
              s1: 0.1,
              color: '#ffe45c',
              kind: KIND_STAR,
            })
          }
          break
        }
        case 'flee': {
          eyeY *= 1.2
          eyeX = 1.1
          mouthOpen = 0.4
          smile = 0
          pitch += 0.15
          break
        }
        case 'hunt': {
          eyeY *= 0.9
          pitch += 0.12
          smileX = 1.25
          break
        }
        case 'fading': {
          const k = clamp(b.fade / C.FADE, 0, 1)
          const s = 1 - k * k
          sx *= s
          sy *= s
          hop = k * 0.4
          eyeY = 0.12
          yawWob = k * 6
          brightness = 1 - k * 0.35
          smile = 0
          break
        }
        default:
          break
      }

      if (b.justBorn > 0 && act !== 'fading') {
        const k = 1 - b.justBorn / 0.9
        const s = easeOutBack(clamp(k, 0, 1))
        sx *= s
        sy *= s
        hop += Math.sin(clamp(k, 0, 1) * Math.PI) * 0.35
        glowAmt = Math.max(glowAmt, 0.7 * (1 - k))
        glowTint = WHITE
        glowSize = 1.4 + k * 1.6
      }

      if (v.wobble > 0 && act !== 'stunned') {
        sy += Math.sin(T * 22) * 0.07 * v.wobble
        sx -= Math.sin(T * 22) * 0.035 * v.wobble
      }
      if (v.happy > 0) {
        hop += Math.sin(clamp(1 - v.happy, 0, 1) * Math.PI) * 0.28
        brightness += 0.18 * v.happy
      }

      const growth = 0.62 + 0.38 * clamp(b.age / 14, 0, 1)
      const eScale = 0.93 + 0.13 * (b.energy / C.MAX_ENERGY)
      const size = growth * eScale
      const geneLen = 1 + (b.speedGene - 1) * 0.22
      const eyeSize = (isBlue ? 1 : 0.9) * (0.9 + 0.12 * b.visionGene)

      const slotIdx = n
      const fadeScale = act === 'fading' ? 1 : 1

      eul.set(pitch, Math.PI / 2 - v.heading + yawWob, v.roll, 'YXZ')
      q.setFromEuler(eul)
      const bodyScaleX = sx * size * fadeScale
      const bodyScaleY = Math.max(0.02, sy) * size
      const bodyScaleZ = Math.max(0.02, (1 / Math.sqrt(Math.max(0.5, sx))) * size * geneLen)
      bodyM.compose(vp.set(wx, hop, wz), q, vs.set(bodyScaleX, bodyScaleY, bodyScaleZ))
      this.bodies.setMatrixAt(slotIdx, bodyM)

      const baseCol = isBlue ? BLUE_COLOR : RED_COLOR
      col.copy(baseCol)
      if (lowE > 0) col.lerp(GRAY, 0.4 * lowE)
      const glowMix = glowAmt * 0.18
      col.lerp(WHITE, glowMix)
      col.multiplyScalar(brightness)
      this.bodies.setColorAt(slotIdx, col)

      const face = (mesh: THREE.InstancedMesh, off: THREE.Vector3, sX: number, sY: number, sZ: number) => {
        tmpM2.compose(off, IDQ, vs.set(sX, sY, sZ))
        mesh.setMatrixAt(slotIdx, tmpM.multiplyMatrices(bodyM, tmpM2))
      }
      const es = eyeSize
      face(this.eyes, EYE_CENTER, es * eyeX, Math.max(0.02, es * eyeY), es)
      face(this.brows, BROW_CENTER, isBlue ? 0 : 1, isBlue ? 0 : act === 'pause' ? 0.5 : act === 'hunt' ? 1.3 : 1, isBlue ? 0 : 1)
      if (mouthOpen > 0.05) {
        face(this.mouths, MOUTH_POS, 0.7 + 0.5 * mouthOpen, 0.15 + 1.0 * mouthOpen, 1)
        face(this.smiles, MOUTH_POS, 0, 0, 0)
      } else {
        face(this.mouths, MOUTH_POS, 0, 0, 0)
        const lowSmile = lowE > 0.5 ? -1 : 1
        face(this.smiles, MOUTH_POS, (isBlue ? 1 : 1.25) * smileX * smile, lowSmile * smile, 1)
      }
      face(this.cheeks, CHEEK_L, blush, blush, blush)
      tmpM2.compose(CHEEK_R, IDQ, vs.set(blush, blush, blush))
      this.cheeks.setMatrixAt(slotIdx + BLOB_CAP > 0 ? slotIdx : slotIdx, tmpM.multiplyMatrices(bodyM, tmpM2))

      const shadowS = (1.5 + 0.2 * (size - 1)) * size * (1 - hop * 0.8) * (act === 'fading' ? 1 - clamp(b.fade / C.FADE, 0, 1) : 1)
      tmpM.compose(vp.set(wx, 0.035, wz), IDQ, vs.set(shadowS * 1.15, 1, shadowS * 1.15))
      this.shadows.setMatrixAt(slotIdx, tmpM)

      if (glowAmt > 0.01) {
        const gs = glowSize * size
        tmpM.compose(vp.set(wx, 0.05, wz), IDQ, vs.set(gs, 1, gs))
        this.glows.setMatrixAt(slotIdx, tmpM)
        col.copy(glowTint).multiplyScalar(glowAmt)
        this.glows.setColorAt(slotIdx, col)
      } else {
        tmpM.compose(vp.set(wx, 0.05, wz), IDQ, vs.set(0, 0, 0))
        this.glows.setMatrixAt(slotIdx, tmpM)
      }

      if (act === 'eat' && b.eatTree >= 0 && heldN < 250) {
        const tot = Math.max(0.3, b.timerMax)
        const flyDur = Math.min(0.42, tot * 0.45)
        const f = clamp(b.actionTime / flyDur, 0, 1)
        this.slotWorld(b.eatTree, b.eatSlot, vp)
        const sx0 = vp.x
        const sy0 = vp.y
        const sz0 = vp.z
        const mouth = MOUTH_POS
        const ch = Math.cos(v.heading)
        const sh = Math.sin(v.heading)
        const mx = wx + ch * mouth.z * size
        const mz = wz + sh * mouth.z * size
        const my = mouth.y * size * 0.9 + hop
        const e = f * f * (3 - 2 * f)
        const px = sx0 + (mx - sx0) * e
        const pz = sz0 + (mz - sz0) * e
        const py = sy0 + (my - sy0) * e + Math.sin(f * Math.PI) * 0.7
        let fs = 1.05
        if (f >= 1) {
          const c = clamp((b.actionTime - flyDur) / Math.max(0.1, tot - flyDur), 0, 1)
          const bite = 0.88 + 0.12 * Math.cos(c * Math.PI * 7)
          fs = (1 - c * 0.92) * bite * 0.9
        }
        q2.setFromAxisAngle(AXIS_Y, T * 3)
        tmpM.compose(vp.set(px, py, pz), q2, vs.set(fs, fs, fs))
        this.held.setMatrixAt(heldN++, tmpM)
      }
      n++
    }

    for (const m of [this.bodies, this.eyes, this.brows, this.smiles, this.mouths, this.cheeks, this.shadows, this.glows]) {
      m.count = n
      m.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true
    }
    this.bodies.instanceColor!.needsUpdate = true
    this.glows.instanceColor!.needsUpdate = true
    this.held.count = heldN
    this.held.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true

    this.gcTimer += dt
    if (this.gcTimer > 2) {
      this.gcTimer = 0
      for (const [id, v] of this.vis) if (v.seen < stamp - 1) this.vis.delete(id)
    }
  }

  private updateSelection(world: World, dt: number) {
    const id = this.selectedId
    const b = id !== null ? world.byId.get(id) : undefined
    if (!b || b.dead) {
      if (id !== null && (!b || b.dead)) {
        this.selectedId = null
        this.onPick(null)
      }
      this.selRing.visible = false
      this.selArrow.visible = false
      this.visionRing.visible = false
    } else {
      const v = this.vis.get(b.id)
      const x = v?.rx ?? b.x
      const z = v?.rz ?? b.y
      const pulse = 1 + Math.sin(this.time * 4) * 0.06
      this.selRing.visible = true
      this.selRing.position.set(x, 0.07, z)
      this.selRing.scale.setScalar(pulse * 1.05)
      this.selArrow.visible = true
      this.selArrow.position.set(x, 2.05 + Math.sin(this.time * 3.2) * 0.14, z)
      this.selArrow.rotation.y = this.time * 1.5
      ;(this.selArrow.material as THREE.MeshBasicMaterial).color.set(b.kind === BLUE ? '#8fc7ff' : '#ff9aac')
      const vision = (b.kind === BLUE ? world.params.blueVision : world.params.redVision) * b.visionGene
      this.visionRing.visible = true
      this.visionRing.position.set(x, 0.08, z)
      this.visionRing.scale.set(vision, 1, vision)
      if (this.follow) {
        const t = this.controls.target
        const k = 1 - Math.exp(-dt * 4)
        const dx = (x - t.x) * k
        const dz = (z - t.z) * k
        t.x += dx
        t.z += dz
        this.camera.position.x += dx
        this.camera.position.z += dz
      }
    }

    const hb = this.hoverId !== null && this.hoverId !== this.selectedId ? world.byId.get(this.hoverId) : undefined
    if (hb && !hb.dead) {
      const v = this.vis.get(hb.id)
      this.hoverRing.visible = true
      this.hoverRing.position.set(v?.rx ?? hb.x, 0.06, v?.rz ?? hb.y)
    } else {
      this.hoverRing.visible = false
    }
  }

  select(id: number | null) {
    this.selectedId = id
  }

  setFollow(f: boolean) {
    this.follow = f
    if (!f) this.controls.target.y = 0
  }

  setAutoRotate(on: boolean) {
    this.controls.autoRotate = on
  }

  get autoRotate() {
    return this.controls.autoRotate
  }

  private resize() {
    const w = Math.max(1, this.container.clientWidth)
    const h = Math.max(1, this.container.clientHeight)
    this.renderer.setSize(w, h, false)
    this.camera.aspect = w / h
    const wide = w / h
    this.camera.fov = wide < 0.9 ? 46 : 36
    this.camera.updateProjectionMatrix()
    const pr = this.renderer.getPixelRatio()
    this.particles.setScale((h * pr * 0.5) / Math.tan((this.camera.fov * Math.PI) / 360))
  }

  private pickAt(clientX: number, clientY: number): number | null {
    const world = this.world
    if (!world) return null
    const rect = this.renderer.domElement.getBoundingClientRect()
    const px = clientX - rect.left
    const py = clientY - rect.top
    const dist = this.camera.position.distanceTo(this.controls.target)
    const pxPerUnit = rect.height / 2 / (Math.tan((this.camera.fov * Math.PI) / 360) * dist)
    const thr = Math.max(20, pxPerUnit * 0.95)
    let best: number | null = null
    let bestD = 1
    for (const b of world.blobs) {
      if (b.dead) continue
      const v = this.vis.get(b.id)
      vp.set(v?.rx ?? b.x, 0.5, v?.rz ?? b.y).project(this.camera)
      const sx = (vp.x * 0.5 + 0.5) * rect.width
      const sy = (-vp.y * 0.5 + 0.5) * rect.height
      const d = Math.hypot(sx - px, sy - py) / thr
      if (d < bestD) {
        bestD = d
        best = b.id
      }
    }
    return best
  }

  private onDown = (e: PointerEvent) => {
    this.downX = e.clientX
    this.downY = e.clientY
    this.downT = performance.now()
  }

  private onUp = (e: PointerEvent) => {
    const moved = Math.hypot(e.clientX - this.downX, e.clientY - this.downY)
    if (moved > 6 || performance.now() - this.downT > 700) return
    const id = this.pickAt(e.clientX, e.clientY)
    this.selectedId = id
    this.onPick(id)
  }

  private onMove = (e: PointerEvent) => {
    const now = performance.now()
    if (e.buttons) return
    if (now - this.lastHoverCheck < 60) return
    this.lastHoverCheck = now
    const id = this.pickAt(e.clientX, e.clientY)
    this.hoverId = id
    this.renderer.domElement.style.cursor = id !== null ? 'pointer' : 'grab'
  }

  private onLeave = () => {
    this.hoverId = null
  }

  dispose() {
    const el = this.renderer.domElement
    el.removeEventListener('pointerdown', this.onDown)
    el.removeEventListener('pointerup', this.onUp)
    el.removeEventListener('pointermove', this.onMove)
    el.removeEventListener('pointerleave', this.onLeave)
    this.resizeObs.disconnect()
    this.controls.dispose()
    this.disposeGroup(this.staticGroup)
    this.particles.dispose()
    this.ringTex.dispose()
    this.shadowTex.dispose()
    this.renderer.dispose()
    el.remove()
  }
}
